t:
Section 224 of the Protecting Access to Medicare Act of 2014 (42 U.S.C. 290aa note) is amended—
    (1) in subsection (e), by striking “and 2018,” and inserting “2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022,”; and 
    (2) in subsection (g)—
        (A) in paragraph (1), by striking “2018” and inserting “2022”; and 
        (B) in paragraph (2), by striking “is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2018” and inserting “are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2017, $20,000,000 for fiscal year 2018, $19,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020, and $18,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 and 2022”.

fable.w: This section only extends fiscal-year dates and revises the authorization of appropriations for an existing program. The tempting reading is that the amended program might involve outside parties, but nothing in this text establishes a comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with non-federal entities, or a right to sue. Date extensions and funding authorizations bring no outside party into a federal decision.
fable.s: are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2017

qwen_block.w: This section solely amends the authorization of appropriations by changing fiscal years and dollar amounts. It does not establish any process for consulting with or coordinating with parties outside the federal government, such as the public, states, or experts. The changes are purely administrative and financial, involving only federal actors.
qwen_block.s: Section 224 of the Protecting Access to Medicare Act of 2014 (42 U.S.C. 290aa note) is amended— (1) in subsection (e), by striking “and 2018,” and inserting “2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022,”; and (2) in subsection (g)— (A) in paragraph (1), by striking “2018” and inserting “2022”; and (B) in paragraph (2), by striking “is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2018” and inserting “are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2017, $20,000,000 for fiscal year 2018, $19,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 and 2020, and $18,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 and 2022”.
qwen_block.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because this section amends a statute that likely involves grants or programs, it implicitly involves participation. However, the text itself only changes dates and dollar amounts for appropriations. There is no mention of public comment, hearings, advisory boards with outside members, or consultation with non-federal entities. The actors involved are Congress (appropriating funds) and the federal agency (carrying out the section), which are all inside the government.

opus.w: This section only extends the program's years and changes how much money is authorized for it. It does not require or allow the federal government to consult anyone outside the government, hold a hearing or comment period, issue rules, or create an advisory body. Any outside involvement in the underlying grant program would be grant applications, which the definition excludes from participation.
opus.s: are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2017, $20,000,000 for fiscal year 2018
